prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a new HIGH-LEVEL overview illustration using the supplied image only as a STYLE reference. Match refined tactile paper sculpture, cream fibrous paper, deep teal and sage cardstock, amber highlights, white studio background, soft shadows. Very wide landscape 2:1 composition, generous negative space, sparse objects, large readable serif labels. No overall title.
Flow left to right: a cream clinic letter with abstract gray prose and two amber highlights, label "Clinic letter"; a small forward teal arrow labelled "Extract"; an open compact teal evidence folio, label "Saved record" in white on teal. The folio contains two tidy cream fact cards showing an amber quotation stripe above small structured gray fields, plus a smaller separate selection slip. NO readable clinical text or field names on these cards. This must look like an organised record, not merely two loose quote scraps.
From this ONE saved record, two clear equal forward arrows branch to upper-right and lower-right decision objects. Upper-right is a cream tile with a sculpted teal if/then branching tree symbol, labelled "Rules". Lower-right is a matching cream tile with a sculpted teal layered connected-node network, labelled "LLM". A single label "Decide" above the fork groups both alternatives. Both branches receive the SAME record; no original letter bypass to either decision.
Only permitted text: "Clinic letter", "Extract", "Saved record", "Decide", "Rules", "LLM". No quotations, numbers, calendars, results, rationale paragraphs, legends, footers or UI panels. Avoid excessive stacked papers. This overview must be visually simpler than the detailed reference.
